qa.q: Will it cool my room on May afternoons?
qa.answer: It probably won’t keep your 180 sq ft room comfortable on hot May afternoons. Your room needs about 1.75 ton cooling (including +15 % for top-floor/west sun and +10 % for a very hot city) but this unit is only 1 ton [CHK-COOL] [ SPEC:capacity_tons]. While it can handle Jaipur’s peak 46 °C outside temperature [CHK-HEAT], the capacity shortfall means it will struggle in the afternoon heat.

qa.q: Do I need a stabilizer?
qa.answer: You don’t need a stabilizer - the unit works from 145 V to 290 V, covering your fluctuating supply. [CHK-VOLT] [SPEC:voltage_range_v]

qa.q: Is it quiet enough for a bedroom?
qa.answer: Yes, it’s quiet enough for a bedroom. The indoor unit runs at 38 dB noise level[SPEC:noise_db], and a reviewer noted the indoor unit is “quiet enough to sleep”[R-AC02-11].

qa.q: How many decibels is the indoor unit?
qa.answer: The listing and reviews do not provide the indoor unit’s decibel level. You may ask the seller in the product Q&A for that information.

qa.q: Is the condenser copper?
qa.answer: Yes, the condenser is copper[SPEC:condenser].

qa.q: What is the warranty on the compressor?
qa.answer: The compressor comes with a 10-year warranty. [SPEC:warranty_compressor_years]

qa.q: Will it fit my window?
qa.answer: No, it won’t fit your window. Your window is 55 cm × 45 cm, but the AC needs an opening of 61 cm × 41 cm [CHK-FIT][SPEC:window_opening_cm].

qa.q: What is the annual energy use?
qa.answer: The AeroChill 1.5 Ton AC uses about **990 kWh per year** in operation[SPEC:annual_kwh].

qa.q: Is it too big for my room?
qa.answer: Yes, it’s larger than needed for your 100 sq ft room. The AC is 2 ton, while your room requires only about 0.77 ton, so it will cool quickly but may make the space clammy and cost more to run. [CHK-COOL]

qa.q: Will it fast-charge my phone?
qa.answer: Yes, it will fast-charge your Orbit S24 Ultra, but only up to about 25 W (PPS) rather than the phone’s full 45 W capability [CHK-FAST][SPEC:ports]. The box includes a USB-C to USB-C cable that fits your phone’s USB-C port [CHK-CABLE][SPEC:cable_included].

qa.q: Do I need another cable?
qa.answer: Yes, you’ll need a separate USB-C to Lightning cable because the charger doesn’t include one. [CHK-CABLE]

qa.q: Can it charge my laptop too?
